title: Provençal Vegetable Tian with Thyme and Garlic
summary: Aubergine, green and yellow courgette and tomato rounds stood on edge in rings over sliced onion, seasoned with garlic, thyme and chilli flakes and baked in olive oil.
equipment: 28 cm round baking dish (about 5 cm deep)

ingredients.item: medium aubergine, cut into 1 cm rounds
medium courgettes, cut into 1 cm rounds
yellow courgette, cut into 1 cm rounds
medium tomatoes, cut into 1 cm rounds
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Prepare the dish
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Rub the inside of the dish with the cut sides of the halved garlic clove, then coat the base with 2 tbsp oil and scatter the onion over it.

steps.title: Arrange the vegetables
steps.text: Stand the aubergine, courgette, yellow courgette and tomato rounds on edge in alternating, tightly overlapping rings, working from the outside in, and season with the salt, pepper and chilli flakes as you go. Choosing vegetables of a similar width makes the rings neat and helps everything cook evenly.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Scatter the thyme and sliced garlic over the top and drizzle with the remaining 3 tbsp oil.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake for 25 min, then spoon the oil from the dish over the vegetables and bake for about 25 min more, until they are tender to the tip of a knife and browned at the edges. Basting halfway keeps the top from drying out. Rest for 10 min and serve warm or at room temperature.

tips: Slice everything 1 cm thick so it all cooks at the same rate.
A mandoline makes quick, even work of the slicing.
Leftovers are excellent cold the next day, or stirred through pasta.
storage: Refrigerate covered up to 3 days. Serve at room temperature or reheat in the oven until piping hot (74 °C). Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
